name: Lektor
description: Lektor is a Python static content management system that builds sites from per-page contents.lr files, data models and Jinja2 templates.
notes: Lektor reads one contents.lr per page, so the timed build_command first converts each generated posts/<name>.md into content/posts/<name>/contents.lr with bash builtins only (one mkdir, one read and one printf per post, no per-post forks). Minimal custom models and templates; build state is written to .lektor-cache.
